title: HSE HSG179 Health and safety in swimming pools
notes: Guidance, so its findings are notes. Chosen in England (the UK Approved Document K code setting). Lifeguard numbers, the scan rule, depth signs and the 1.35 m non-swimmer boundary need markings and staffing Riviera does not model yet.

pool.description: A starting point for the maximum bathing load: 3 m² of water a bather
Depth markings showing the actual depth, especially at the shallow and deep ends and sudden changes, readable from the surround and the water, in metres
